Activity - Product: GDP By Production = Sum of Gross Output (GO) - Sum of Intermediate Inputs (II) + Sum of Import Duty for all Products (ID)
GDP by Expenditure Approach = Household Final Concumption (C) + Gross Fixed Capital Formation & Inventory (I) + Government Final Consumption (G) + [Exports(X) - Imports(M)]
GDP by Income Approach = [Taxes (T) - Subsidies(S)] + Consumption of Fixed Capital (D) + Compensation of Employees (CE) + Operating Surplus(OS) + Import Duty (ID)
